summary:
- **[key4hep/k4geo](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo)** — Major detector geometry updates for FCC: the FCC-SEED vertex detector is added as an option across all FCC detector concepts, with a refactor of the IDEA/ALLEGRO vertex detectors and introduction of `CLD_o5_v01` (FCC-SEED default) plus `CLD_o1_v09` fixing the CLD disk material budget ([#612](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/612)). ALLEGRO also gets a fix to the HCAL Endcap pseudo-layer position calculation used by PandoraPFA ([#666](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/666)). Additionally, `dd4hep2root.py` now maps volumes to the closest predefined ROOT color for improved visualization ([#662](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/662)).
- **[key4hep/k4RecTracker](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker)** — `DCHdigi_v02` is renamed to `WireTrackerDigi_v01`, a unified digitizer that now handles both drift chamber and straw-tube tracker (STT) hits via a new `isSTT` Gaudi property (which remaps `nphi`→`tube` and uses `sector` in the cellID) ([#100](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker/pull/100)). This is a user-visible rename and requires corresponding steering updates; the change caused GenFit-based track fitting configurations to break until the `WireTrackerName` property was updated.
- **[hep-fcc/FCC-config](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config)** — Follow-on updates for the WireTracker rename: fixes `k4run` crashes in ALLEGRO/IDEA `run_digi_reco.py` after the `DCHdigi_v02 → WireTrackerDigi_v01` renaming ([#395](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/395)), and enables the STT digitizer in ALLEGRO reconstruction via the `isSTT` property (requires a matching `WireTrackerName` fix in GenfitTrackFitter to avoid segfaults) ([#388](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/388)). Also restores the IDEA Delphes/EDM4hep cards on `main` and refreshes ZH/ZZ/WW Pythia8 generator cards to `winter2023` ([#393](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/393)); and adds a track validation option for IDEA plus exposes it in the IDEA/ALLEGRO ctests ([#386](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/386)).
- **[key4hep/EDM4hep](https://github.com/key4hep/EDM4hep)** — Hides the deprecated `Track::getTrackState(int32_t)` overload from Cling/cppyy to work around wrong overload selection in Python bindings ([#524](https://github.com/key4hep/EDM4hep/pull/524)).
- **[key4hep/k4SimDelphes](https://github.com/key4hep/k4SimDelphes)** — Stores photon pointing angles (`ITheta`, `IPhi`) with directional error, and computes/stores hit position error (`errorPhi`, `errorTheta`) in the Delphes→EDM4hep converter, enabling photon-pointing analyses downstream ([#161](https://github.com/key4hep/k4SimDelphes/pull/161)). Requires Delphes ≥ 3.5.2pre02.
- **[key4hep/k4ActsTracking](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking)** — Adds a GNN edge sorting/flipping stage (`SortEdges`) to re-orient graph edges from the hit closer to the IP outward, reproducing the acorn training convention required for correct GNN track finding inference ([#103](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/103)). Also makes `--compactFile` a required argument in the CKF, GNN, and geometry-visualization options scripts, replacing a cryptic Gaudi failure with a clear error ([#97](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/97)).
- **[key4hep/k4FWCore](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore)** — Adds an `--evt-max` alias to `k4run` mirroring `ApplicationMgr.EvtMax` for clarity when limiting event counts ([#431](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore/pull/431)).
- **[key4hep/k4geo](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo)** (MUSIC — muon collider, non-FCC): *(omitted per FCC-only repository rule; see Omitted)*
- **[AIDASoft/DD4hep](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep)** — Removes the CSG-based CAD (ASSIMP) exporter in DDCAD because ROOT made `RCsg`/`CsgOps.h` private, unblocking builds against current ROOT ([#1681](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1681)); a follow-up reimplementation using public ROOT interfaces is planned to restore functionality.
- **[hep-fcc/FCCeePhysicsStudies](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCCeePhysicsStudies)** — Adds updated FSR beam parameters (still GHC lattice numbers, as LCC values above the Z pole are not yet available) ([#61](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCCeePhysicsStudies/pull/61)).
